source_text: By 2025, some former members of the AAP's 2012 Circumcision Task Force called for a renewed ethical and scientific review of U.S. guidance, arguing that evolving evidence on long-term outcomes and bodily autonomy warrants transparent reevaluation, though major medical bodies have not altered their pro-circumcision stances. [88]
